a horizontal member carrying load across a span
the vertical element that encloses and divides space
a flat horizontal element forming a floor or roof
items.s: Wall: the vertical element that encloses and divides space. The other options describe Slab, Beam, Column.

items.q: Schematic design may be defined as
o: the stage that fixes materials, structure and services
the client's and users' response used to improve the design
the developed proposal showing arrangement and scale
the staged work from brief to completed design
items.s: Schematic design: the developed proposal showing arrangement and scale. The other options describe Feedback, Architectural design process, Design development.

items.q: Select the statement that correctly explains Modern architecture.
o: the curved structural form that Roman builders made central
the column, capital and entablature system of Greek temples
heavy stone building with columns and massive walls
twentieth century building in new materials with little ornament
items.s: Modern architecture: twentieth century building in new materials with little ornament. The other options describe Roman arch, Ancient Egyptian architecture, Greek classical order.

items.q: The correct meaning of Lintel is
o: a horizontal member carrying load across a span
the member spanning over an opening to carry the wall above
the series of steps joining one level to another
the vertical element that encloses and divides space
items.s: Lintel: the member spanning over an opening to carry the wall above. The other options describe Stair, Beam, Wall.

items.q: “the person or body for whom a building is designed” is the definition of
o: Function
Architecture
Client
Brief
items.s: Client is the person or body for whom a building is designed.

items.q: “the curved structural form that Roman builders made central” is the definition of
o: Greek classical order
Roman arch
Vernacular architecture
Ancient Egyptian architecture
items.s: Roman arch is the curved structural form that Roman builders made central.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines Modern architecture?
o: pointed arches, ribbed vaults and flying buttresses
the revival of classical order and proportion
twentieth century building in new materials with little ornament
the column, capital and entablature system of Greek temples
items.s: Modern architecture: twentieth century building in new materials with little ornament. The other options describe Gothic architecture, Renaissance architecture, Greek classical order.

items.q: In this course, Structural frame refers to
o: the layer that stops moisture rising through a wall
the skeleton of columns and beams that carries the building
the covering that sheds rain and sun from a building
the part of a building that carries its loads into the ground
items.s: Structural frame: the skeleton of columns and beams that carries the building. The other options describe Roof, Foundation, Damp proof course.

items.q: The correct meaning of Damp proof course is
o: a vertical member carrying load in compression
the series of steps joining one level to another
the layer that stops moisture rising through a wall
a gap made in a wall for a door or window
items.s: Damp proof course: the layer that stops moisture rising through a wall. The other options describe Opening, Stair, Column.

items.q: The correct meaning of Axis is
o: a flat surface that defines a boundary in space
repetition of elements at regular intervals
an imaginary line that organises a plan
the outward shape and volume of a building
items.s: Axis: an imaginary line that organises a plan. The other options describe Rhythm, Plane, Form.

items.q: Vernacular architecture may be defined as
o: heavy stone building with columns and massive walls
the curved structural form that Roman builders made central
building shaped by local materials, climate and custom
pointed arches, ribbed vaults and flying buttresses
items.s: Vernacular architecture: building shaped by local materials, climate and custom. The other options describe Roman arch, Ancient Egyptian architecture, Gothic architecture.

items.q: In this course, Built environment refers to
o: the human made surroundings in which people live and work
the client's statement of what a building must provide
the relationship between a building's size and the human being
the professional who designs buildings and supervises their construction
items.s: Built environment: the human made surroundings in which people live and work. The other options describe Brief, Architect, Scale in architecture.

items.q: In this course, Architecture refers to
o: the person or body for whom a building is designed
the pleasing relationship between the parts of a building and the whole
the use a building is designed to serve
the art and science of designing buildings fit for their purpose
items.s: Architecture: the art and science of designing buildings fit for their purpose. The other options describe Client, Proportion, Function.
